title: Scheduled polls use a stale focus-state snapshot
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ### Problem  `startNextPoll` reads `const state = api.getState()[reducerPath]` when it schedules a timeout, then the timeout callback checks `state.config.focused`. title: Condition-rejected duplicate queries prematurely flush delayed invalidations
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ### Problem  The delayed-invalidation handler increments its pending counter for query/mutation `pending` actions, but decrements it for every fulfilled/rejected thunk. title: A tag with a falsy ID is never invalidated
author: petr-kratochvil
body_preview: ### Summary  When a tag has a falsy ID, it is treated as _without ID_ on writing, but as _with ID_ on read and cleanup.  Consequences: - The tag is never effectivelly invalidated by such ID - The stale query references accumulate (instead of being cleaned up after unsubscribe)  ### Minimal reproduction  Tested on: "@reduxjs/toolkit": "2.12.0". author: kollner
body_preview: ## Describe the bug  Since 5.102.0 the `added` message carries the new query's initial state (`status: 'pending'`, `data: undefined`).
